title: A receipt billed again on a later bill
change: bill.json here is a second bill for August (HARBOR-DEMO-2026-08-002), cut from the same manifest. It bills a single receipt, receipt 65 (sha256:21085be01df916f42b1d9b5c905ac7bffe27589834153c875890fca738624236), and excludes every other receipt, as billed on the first bill or as not billable. The first bill (../../bill.json) is given as an earlier bill, and it already billed receipt 65.
why: Uniqueness against earlier bills: a receipt is billed at most once across the bills the paying side is given. Taken alone, this bill passes every other claim.
